prompt: A table holding both internal engineering docs and public help-center articles. Customer question: "how do I reset my password?"

options.label: Vector search alone
options.content: Finds the closest-matching vectors across the ENTIRE table, internal and public alike. If an internal engineering doc about the password-reset system's implementation happens to score as semantically close (it's about the same topic, after all), it's eligible to be returned right alongside the public help article - vector similarity alone has no concept of which documents a customer should actually see.

options.label: Vector search + metadata filter (doc_type = 'public')
options.content: The SQL filter excludes every internal document before similarity ranking even runs on what's left. Only public help-center articles are eligible candidates at all - vector similarity is now deciding which of the ALLOWED documents is the best match, not deciding whether an internal doc should leak through because it happened to be topically close.
